انتشقتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَشَقْتُنَّ (intašaqtunna) /in.ta.ʃaq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# اُنْتُشِقْتُنَّ (untušiqtunna) /un.tu.ʃiq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
